_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the weekly-git-digest Claude Managed Agent. The other files in this folder (system.md, agent.json, environment.json, outcome.md, first_prompt.txt, deployment.json) are projections of this sheet. Authored keyless 2026-06-27 from locked decisions; NOT launched. Validate payloads against live docs before launch (live docs win).

meta.name: weekly-git-digest
meta.problem: Each Thursday evening, summarize the week's git activity by project and publish it into the Claude Bridge HQ Notion area, off-box, without the laptop needing to be on.
meta.status: PLANNED (keyless build kit staged; live launch gated on Part-C checklist)

agent.name: weekly-git-digest
agent.model_rationale: Quality-first; a weekly run costs cents. Switch to a Sonnet-class model if cost matters more later.
never_dos: Never echo GITHUB_TOKEN / NOTION_TOKEN or any secret in output, logs, or the digest
Never post anywhere except the configured Notion parent page
Never fabricate commits or PRs; mark anything unverified
Never use web_search (disabled); only api.github.com and api.notion.com are reachable

outcome.description: Produce and idempotently publish this week's git digest

tools.rationale: Direct GitHub + Notion REST via bash/curl using vault-injected tokens; web_search OFF to remove a broad exfil channel (premortem #6). web_fetch stays but is contained by environment networking allowlist.

vault_credentials.scope: GitHub fine-grained PAT, contents:read + pull_requests:read, on the target repos, with an expiry
Notion internal-integration token, shared with the dedicated child page ONLY

config_non_secret.NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID: <FILL: the dedicated child page under Claude Bridge HQ 30e76fd7ac8281e99fe1c0b257088b34 — NOT the HQ root>
config_non_secret.REPOS: <FILL: newline list of owner/repo, e.g. Rev4nchist/Continuous-Claude-v3 — start small, expand in v2>

environment.name: weekly-git-digest-env
environment.packages: git (jq/curl/python expected present; confirm at launch)

schedule.expression_meaning: Thursday 19:00 (mid your 6-9pm window; cron fires at one minute, not a range)
schedule.timezone: <FILL: confirm Dave IANA tz; default America/New_York>
schedule.initial_events_source: deployment.json (the same outcome kickoff as first_prompt.txt + outcome.md)

idempotency.policy: Search the Notion parent page for an existing block tagged with the run-key; if found, replace that section's children (upsert); if not, append a new dated section. NEVER blind-append. Read back to verify. Optional memory store persists returned block IDs across runs.
idempotency.rationale: Premortem #2 (duplicate posts on retry/re-fire) + #4 (Notion block-id stability)

evals.case_01: <FILL: a known past week's commits -> expected grouping; save the first verified run as the golden baseline>

next_directions.v1: Wire a real Notion connector via MCP instead of direct API, if richer formatting is wanted

next_directions.v2: Expand REPOS coverage; add a per-project PR-review-time summary

next_directions.v3: Post-cron health monitor as its own tiny scheduled check (G10) -> alert on missing/failed run
